description: Reference history plus 2024-02-05 with low 159.5 (at or below PL 159.94, above DL 157.92) and one calm day.
explanation: Any PL touch after the leg-out makes the zone tested (RB 264, 683-697). D3: a tested zone is never an entry zone and never appears in the candidate list or the fresh-zone report. The overlay must record TESTED and the scanner must list no candidate.
title: The same zone after a later PL touch is TESTED: no candidate
